_about: Allowlist for the official image lane (pipeline/official_image.py, pipeline/lane.py).
youtube_channels: an official trailer/teaser is used only when YouTube's oEmbed author_url for the video is one of these.
author_url is stored exactly as oEmbed returned it; matching ignores case (YouTube handles are case-insensitive).
channel_id is kept for reference (and matched too, in case oEmbed ever returns /channel/<id> URLs).
official_domains: og_image_official only reads pages on these hosts (the host itself or any subdomain of it),
and, where path_prefixes is set, only under those paths.
denied_domains: news outlets, photo agencies and platforms. Checked before the allowlist, for the page, every
redirect and the image URL. Licensed agency photos (AP, PTI, ANI, IANS) come only through the licensed_wire
resolver and its APIs, never by reading their websites.
denied_agencies: never used, even if an API returns them (idly has no licence).
To add a source: see RUNBOOK.md, 'Official image lane' -> 'Adding a source'.
